tables.purpose: Yard intake Brix samples, consignment quality, and center-wise condition aggregates
Field Brix samples, maturity, crop/land/soil breakdowns, and hydration trend
Configurable brix_threshold (setting_key = brix_threshold, default 18) used in yard and field threshold metrics
STD date preset bounds and season-compare chip windows (pyFrom/pyTo)
Resolve VillageOrCenterCode to display labels in center-wise table
Fallback centre/village name resolution for center-wise table

rows.name: Field Samples / Yard Samples
rows.description: Header pill showing total sample count for the active tab (Field or Yard). Subtitle shows the active date preset (MTD, STD, WTD, or Custom).
rows.formula: Field tab: stats.totalSamples.value = COUNT(*) on brix_field_sampling with Date/TestType filters. Yard tab: stats.totalSamples.value = COUNT(*) on brix_yard_sampling with Date/DeliveryPoint filters. Display: Number(value).toLocaleString('en-IN').
rows.comparison: No comparison chip on header metric. Subtitle is rangePreset state (not a calculated value).

rows.name: From
rows.description: Start of the dashboard date window. Clamped to min/max sampling dates for the active tab.
rows.formula: Sent as query param from=YYYY-MM-DD. Backend: brix_yard_sampling.Date >= ? or brix_field_sampling.Date >= ?. First load defaults STD preset anchored to latest data via getCockpitPresetDateRange('STD', ref, seasonMapping).
rows.comparison: Defines current-period window; compare window is derived separately (pyFrom/pyTo).

rows.name: To
rows.description: End of the dashboard date window. Clamped to min/max sampling dates for the active tab.
rows.formula: Sent as query param to=YYYY-MM-DD. Backend: Date <= ?. resolveDashboardToDate(null, maxDate) anchors presets to latest available sample date.
rows.comparison: Reference date for season chip labels (getCockpitSeasonLabels) and compare range resolution.

rows.name: MTD preset
rows.description: Month-to-date quick filter: first day of current calendar month through To date.
rows.formula: getCockpitPresetDateRange('MTD', ref): from = formatYMD(new Date(year, month, 1)), to = formatYMD(ref).
rows.source: Frontend date math; data filtered on brix_yard_sampling.Date or brix_field_sampling.Date
rows.comparison: PP compare chip label: Prev. Month. Prior window: same calendar day range shifted back one month (computePriorPeriodRange).

rows.name: STD preset
rows.description: Season-to-date quick filter: season start from season_mapping for To date through To date; fallback Oct 1 of inferred season year.
rows.formula: getCockpitPresetDateRange('STD', ref, seasonMapping): from = season_mapping.start_date for season containing to, else formatYMD(new Date(seasonStartYear, 9, 1)).
rows.comparison: PP compare chip label: Prev. Season. STD PP uses alignMappedSeasonByDayOffset to prior season day 1 through day N when mapping exists.

rows.name: WTD preset
rows.description: Week-to-date quick filter: Monday of the week containing To date through To date.
rows.formula: getCockpitPresetDateRange('WTD', ref): from = formatYMD(startOfWeekMonday(ref)), to = formatYMD(ref). Monday week start.
rows.comparison: PP compare chip label: Prev. Week. Prior window: start and end dates minus 7 calendar days.

rows.name: Custom preset
rows.description: User-selected From/To dates; activated when date inputs change or Custom button clicked.
rows.formula: rangePreset = 'Custom'; from/to from date inputs after clampToDb.
rows.comparison: PP compare chip label: Prev. Period. Prior window: equal-length window ending the day before current From (computePriorPeriodRange Custom branch).

rows.name: Compare PP chip
rows.description: Prior-period compare option. Label text depends on active date preset.
rows.formula: buildCockpitComparisonOptions: { id: 'PP', label: getCockpitPPLabel(rangePreset) } -> MTD: Prev. Month, STD: Prev. Season, WTD: Prev. Week, Custom: Prev. Period.
rows.comparison: Selecting PP sets comparisonType='PP'. Backend receives pyFrom/pyTo from resolveCockpitCompareRange PP branch.

rows.name: Compare season chip
rows.description: Each season_mapping row except the season containing To date, newest first. Chip label is the season_label.
rows.formula: listCompareSeasonsFromMapping(refIso, seasonMapping) filters out current season; id = 'SEASON:' + season_label.
rows.comparison: Selecting season chip resolves compare window via alignMappedSeasonByDayOffset (STD) or alignMappedSeasonCompareRange (other presets). Badge label is season_label.

rows.name: Compare badge label
rows.description: Text shown next to KPI comparison chips and ChangeBadge on yard summary cards.
rows.formula: compareBadgeLabel = activeCompareRange.label ? 'vs ' + activeCompareRange.label : undefined. Fallback comparisonLabel on BiKpiCard: 'Prev. Period'. BiKpiCard renders 'vs {comparisonLabel}'. ChangeBadge appends label prop after variance and percent.
rows.comparison: PP STD label: Prev. Season. PP MTD: Prev. Month. PP WTD: Prev. Week. PP Custom: Prev. Period. Season chips: season_label string.

rows.name: Operation (TestType)
rows.description: Filters field data to a single TestType or All. Options loaded from distinct TestType values in data.
rows.formula: Query param testType when not All. Backend: TestType = ? on brix_field_sampling. Prev-period query also applies same testType filter.
rows.comparison: Same testType filter applied to pyFrom/pyTo comparison query when prev conditions exist.

rows.name: AVG MID BRIX %
rows.description: Average middle-stalk Brix across all field samples in the selected period and operation filter.
rows.formula: ROUND(AVG(MiddleBrix), 2). Display: value.toFixed(2). Sparkline plots fieldTrend.midBrix by date.
rows.comparison: BiKpiCard chip: delta = ((value - pyValue) / abs(pyValue)) * 100 when pyValue != 0 else 0%; API does not return pyValue (defaults 0 so chip shows 0.0%). Backend also computes change = ROUND(((curr-prev)/prev)*100, 2) and variance = ROUND(curr-prev, 2) with normal coloring (higher is better). Hidden on chip when pyValue=0. Label: vs {compareBadgeLabel or Prev. Period}.

rows.name: AVERAGE MATURITY
rows.description: Average cane maturity ratio (top Brix divided by bottom Brix) across samples where bottom Brix is positive.
rows.formula: ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN BottomBrix > 0 THEN TopBrix / BottomBrix ELSE NULL END), 2). Display: value.toFixed(2). Sparkline uses midBrix series (not maturity).
rows.comparison: BiKpiCard delta from pyValue (not in API; typically 0%). Backend change/variance with normal coloring. Label: vs compare window.

rows.name: TOTAL SAMPLES
rows.description: Count of field Brix sample records in the filtered period.
rows.formula: COUNT(*). Display: Math.round(v).toLocaleString(). Sparkline uses midBrix trend (sample count not sparked).
rows.source: brix_field_sampling (all rows matching Date and TestType filters)
rows.comparison: BiKpiCard delta from pyValue (not in API). Backend change/variance normal coloring. hasCompare requires prior totalSamples > 0.

rows.name: BOTTOM BRIX < {threshold}%
rows.description: Share of samples whose bottom-stalk Brix is below the configurable threshold. Title embeds live threshold (default 18).
rows.formula: THRESHOLD = portal_settings.brix_threshold (default 18, sanitized > 0). pctBottomBrixLt18 = ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN BottomBrix < THRESHOLD THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) * 100, 1). Display: value.toFixed(1). inverseColor (lower is better). Sparkline: bottomBrix daily avg.
rows.comparison: BiKpiCard inverseColor: green when delta <= 0. Backend mk(..., { lowerBetter: true }): isUp when variance <= 0. change = ROUND(((curr-prev)/prev)*100, 2). THRESHOLD DYNAMIC from portal_settings.brix_threshold, default 18.

rows.name: Bottom Brix
rows.description: Daily average bottom-stalk Brix over the selected period.
rows.formula: Per date group: ROUND(AVG(BottomBrix), 2) aliased bottomBrix in trend query (field brix-trend endpoint groups by Date).
rows.comparison: No per-series comparison on chart. Tooltip shows value.toFixed(2) for non-integers.

rows.name: Mid Brix
rows.description: Daily average middle-stalk Brix over the selected period.
rows.formula: Per date: ROUND(AVG(MiddleBrix), 2) as midBrix.
rows.comparison: No chart comparison. Y-axis domain fixed [0, 35].

rows.name: Top Brix
rows.description: Daily average top-stalk Brix over the selected period.
rows.formula: Per date: ROUND(AVG(TopBrix), 2) as topBrix.

rows.name: Crop condition slice count
rows.description: Each pie slice is sample count for a CropCondition value. Null CropCondition coalesced to Good in SQL.
rows.formula: SELECT COALESCE(CropCondition, 'Good') AS condition, COUNT(*) AS count GROUP BY condition ORDER BY count DESC. Frontend maps to pie value = count, name = condition.

rows.name: Pie center Good %
rows.description: Center overlay text '99.8%' and 'Good' label inside the Crop Standing donut. Static JSX placeholder, not computed from live API data.
rows.formula: Hardcoded in BrixSamplingDashboard.jsx: span text '99.8%' and 'Good'. Does not update when fieldCropCond loads.

rows.name: Footer Good summary
rows.description: Footer row 'Good: 2.64K (99.8%)'. Static placeholder text, not computed from live crop condition data.
rows.formula: Hardcoded JSX strings '2.64K (99.8%)' and '4 (0.2%)' for Diseased.

rows.name: Footer Diseased summary
rows.description: Footer row 'Diseased: 4 (0.2%)'. Static placeholder, not from API.
rows.formula: Hardcoded JSX.

rows.name: Land type slice samples
rows.description: Each pie slice size is sample count per LandType. Excludes null/empty LandType at query level for landType endpoint.
rows.formula: SELECT LandType AS name, COUNT(*) AS samples ... WHERE LandType IS NOT NULL AND LandType != '' GROUP BY LandType. Pie dataKey value = samples.

rows.name: Footer Upland summary
rows.description: Footer 'Upland: 80% (2.12K)'. Static placeholder, not computed from live landType data.
rows.formula: Hardcoded JSX '80% (2.12K)'.

rows.name: Footer Lowland summary
rows.description: Footer 'Lowland: 20% (526)'. Static placeholder, not from API.
rows.formula: Hardcoded JSX '20% (526)'.

rows.subSection: Brix Trend - Hydration and Field Condition
rows.name: No Water
rows.description: Daily average middle Brix for samples where FieldCondition = 'No Water'.
rows.formula: Per date: ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN FieldCondition = 'No Water' THEN MiddleBrix ELSE NULL END), 2) AS noWater. Rows filtered FieldCondition IS NOT NULL AND != ''. connectNulls=true on line.

rows.subSection: Brix Trend - Hydration and Field Condition
rows.name: Avg (overall)
rows.description: Daily average middle Brix across all samples regardless of field condition (dashed grey line).
rows.formula: Per date: ROUND(AVG(MiddleBrix), 2) AS overallAvg.

rows.subSection: Brix Trend - Hydration and Field Condition
rows.name: Waterlogged
rows.description: Daily average middle Brix for samples where FieldCondition = 'Waterlogged'.
rows.formula: Per date: ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN FieldCondition = 'Waterlogged' THEN MiddleBrix ELSE NULL END), 2) AS waterlogged.

rows.name: Samples
rows.description: Bar count of samples per soil type.
rows.formula: COUNT(*) AS samples per SoilType WHERE SoilType IS NOT NULL AND SoilType != ''.

rows.name: Maturity
rows.description: Average maturity ratio per soil type on secondary axis (domain 0.8 to 1.2).
rows.formula: ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN BottomBrix > 0 THEN TopBrix / BottomBrix ELSE NULL END), 3) AS maturity per SoilType.

rows.name: Samples
rows.description: Bar count of samples per cane variety.
rows.formula: COUNT(*) AS samples per Variety WHERE Variety IS NOT NULL AND Variety != ''.

rows.name: Maturity
rows.description: Average maturity ratio per variety on secondary axis (domain 0.8 to 1.2).
rows.formula: ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN BottomBrix > 0 THEN TopBrix / BottomBrix ELSE NULL END), 2) AS maturity per Variety.

rows.name: Point (DeliveryPoint)
rows.description: Filters yard data to one delivery point or All. Options from distinct DeliveryPoint values.
rows.formula: Query param deliveryPoint when not All. Backend: DeliveryPoint = ?. Applied to current and prev-period queries.
rows.comparison: Same deliveryPoint filter on pyFrom/pyTo comparison query.

rows.name: Yard Samples count
rows.description: Inline header count next to 'Yard Intake and Consignment Quality'.
rows.formula: Number(yardStats.totalSamples.value ?? 0).toLocaleString() prefixed in template '{n} Yard Samples'.
rows.source: brix_yard_sampling (COUNT(*) with Date and DeliveryPoint filters)

rows.name: TOTAL SAMPLES
rows.description: Count of yard sample records (lots) in the filtered period.
rows.formula: COUNT(*) as totalSamples. Display: Math.round(v).toLocaleString(). Sparkline: yardTrend.avgBrix by date.
rows.comparison: BiKpiCard delta from pyValue (not in API). Backend change/variance normal coloring.

rows.name: AVG MIDDLE BRIX %
rows.description: Average middle-stalk Brix across yard samples.
rows.formula: ROUND(AVG(MiddleBrix), 2) AS avgBrix. Display: value.toFixed(2).
rows.comparison: BiKpiCard delta from pyValue. Backend change/variance normal coloring.

rows.name: MIDDLE BRIX > {threshold}
rows.description: Share of samples with middle Brix strictly above the configurable threshold. Title embeds threshold value (default 18).
rows.formula: THRESHOLD = portal_settings.brix_threshold (default 18). pctBrixGt18 = ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN MiddleBrix > THRESHOLD THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) * 100, 1). Display: value.toFixed(1). THRESHOLD DYNAMIC.
rows.comparison: BiKpiCard normal coloring. Backend change normal (higher is better).

rows.name: DISEASED CANE
rows.description: Share of samples where DiseasedCane = 'Yes'.
rows.formula: pctDiseased = ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN DiseasedCane = 'Yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) * 100, 1). Display: value.toFixed(1). inverseColor.
rows.comparison: BiKpiCard inverseColor. Backend lowerBetter: isUp when variance <= 0.

rows.name: STALE CANE
rows.description: Share of samples where StaleCane = 'Yes'.
rows.formula: pctStale = ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN StaleCane = 'Yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) * 100, 1). Display: value.toFixed(1). inverseColor.

rows.name: Total Affected Cane
rows.description: Share of samples with diseased or stale cane (either flag Yes). Subtitle: Diseased OR Stale = Yes.
rows.formula: pctAffected = ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN DiseasedCane = 'Yes' OR StaleCane = 'Yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) * 100, 1). Display: '{value}%'.
rows.comparison: ChangeBadge: change = ROUND(((curr-prev)/prev)*100, 2); prev=0 and curr>0 -> 100; prev=0 -> null shows 'No prior data'. variance = ROUND(curr-prev, 2). isUp when variance <= 0 (lower better). Label = compareBadgeLabel. Hidden when hasCompare false (prior totalSamples = 0 or no pyFrom/pyTo).

rows.name: Brix > {threshold} Rate
rows.description: Duplicate display of middle Brix above-threshold rate with formula hint in subtitle. Threshold dynamic (default 18).
rows.formula: Same as pctBrixGt18: ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN MiddleBrix > THRESHOLD THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) * 100, 1). Subtitle text: COUNT(MiddleBrix > THRESHOLD) / Total. THRESHOLD DYNAMIC from portal_settings.brix_threshold.
rows.comparison: ChangeBadge normal coloring (higher is better). Same backend change/variance as pctBrixGt18 KPI.

rows.name: Middle Brix > {threshold}
rows.description: Daily bar count of samples with middle Brix strictly above threshold. Legend name embeds threshold.
rows.formula: Per date: SUM(CASE WHEN MiddleBrix > THRESHOLD THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS countAbove18. THRESHOLD = sanitizeThreshold(getBrixThreshold()). THRESHOLD DYNAMIC.

rows.name: Avg Middle Brix %
rows.description: Daily average middle Brix line on secondary axis (minimum domain 16).
rows.formula: Per date: ROUND(AVG(MiddleBrix), 2) AS avgBrix. YAxis right domain [16, 'auto'].

rows.name: Avg Brix by VehicleType
rows.description: Average middle Brix per vehicle/carrier type, sorted descending by avgBrix.
rows.formula: GROUP BY VehicleType: ROUND(AVG(MiddleBrix), 2) AS avgBrix. Display: '{avgBrix}%'.

rows.name: Samples by VehicleType
rows.description: Sample count shown under each carrier bar.
rows.formula: COUNT(*) AS samples per VehicleType. Display: '{samples} samples'.

rows.name: Carrier bar fill width
rows.description: Horizontal bar width proportional to avg Brix, capped at 25% Brix = full width.
rows.formula: width = Math.min((avgBrix / 25) * 100, 100) percent CSS width.

rows.name: Condition slice count
rows.description: Pie slice count per ConsignmentConditions value. Excludes affected cane (DiseasedCane=Yes OR StaleCane=Yes).
rows.formula: WHERE (existing date/dp filters) AND DiseasedCane = 'No' AND StaleCane = 'No'. GROUP BY ConsignmentConditions, COUNT(*) AS count.

rows.name: Condition legend %
rows.description: Percentage shown beside each condition name in the legend list.
rows.formula: For each condition c: total = SUM(count); display = total > 0 ? Math.round(c.count / total * 100) : 0, shown as '{pct}%'.
rows.source: Derived from brix_yard_sampling.ConsignmentConditions counts in condition distribution query

rows.name: Center
rows.description: Display name for VillageOrCenterCode. Code '0' or empty shows GATE; numeric codes may resolve via purchy tables or show Center #N.
rows.formula: formatCenterLabel(code, nameMap): if code null/0 -> GATE; else nameMap[code] or Center #{code} or raw string. nameMap from purchy_grower_summary and purchy_supply.
rows.source: brix_yard_sampling.VillageOrCenterCode, purchy_grower_summary.centre_code, purchy_grower_summary.centre_name, purchy_grower_summary.village_code, purchy_grower_summary.village_name, purchy_supply.purchsecentre, purchy_supply.purchsecentrename, purchy_supply.villagecode, purchy_supply.villagename

rows.name: Clean
rows.description: Count of samples with ConsignmentConditions = 'Clean' for each center.
rows.formula: SUM(CASE WHEN ConsignmentConditions = 'Clean' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Clean per VillageOrCenterCode.

rows.name: Dry Leaves
rows.description: Count of samples with ConsignmentConditions = 'Dry Leaves' for each center.
rows.formula: SUM(CASE WHEN ConsignmentConditions = 'Dry Leaves' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DryLeaves.

rows.name: Muddy
rows.description: Count of samples with ConsignmentConditions = 'Muddy' for each center.
rows.formula: SUM(CASE WHEN ConsignmentConditions = 'Muddy' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Muddy.

rows.name: Roots
rows.description: Count of samples with ConsignmentConditions = 'Roots' for each center.
rows.formula: SUM(CASE WHEN ConsignmentConditions = 'Roots' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Roots.

rows.name: Total
rows.description: Total sample count per center across all consignment conditions.
rows.formula: COUNT(*) AS Total per VillageOrCenterCode. Rows ordered by Total DESC.

rows.name: Backend comparison change %
rows.description: Percent change used by ChangeBadge and returned in stats objects (value, change, variance, isUp). Prior window filtered by pyFrom/pyTo query params.
rows.formula: hasCompare = prevRow exists AND Number(prevRow.totalSamples) > 0. change = ROUND(((parseFloat(curr)||0 - parseFloat(prev)||0) / parseFloat(prev)) * 100, 2); if prev=0 and curr>0 then 100; if prev=0 then null. variance = ROUND(curr - prev, 2). isUp = lowerBetter ? variance <= 0 : change >= 0.
rows.source: brix_yard_sampling or brix_field_sampling aggregated in current vs pyFrom/pyTo windows
rows.comparison: Sent as pyFrom and pyTo from resolveCockpitCompareRange. Frontend never sends compSeason param; compareMode is priorYear when pyFrom/pyTo set. Hidden when hasCompare false.

rows.name: Brix threshold configuration
rows.description: Admin-configurable threshold driving yard (> threshold) and field (< threshold) bucket metrics. Exposed in stats.brixThreshold and GET /api/bi/settings brixThreshold.
rows.formula: getBrixThreshold(): SELECT setting_value FROM portal_settings WHERE setting_key = 'brix_threshold'. parseFloat; if not finite or <= 0 use 18. sanitizeThreshold splices numeric value into raw SQL for CASE WHEN clauses.
rows.comparison: Threshold applied identically to current and comparison period queries (read live per request).
